A brick comes through the Underwoods' window while Claire has drawn the bodyguard Meechum inside for coffee, and Frank uses it to brand the unions 'disorganized labor.' His televised debate with Spinella backfires when he drags Claire in and fumbles a vowel joke. Frank refuses a direct order from the President to gut the bill, waits on a police scanner for a child to be hurt while out of school, and when a boy is killed he has Zoe tie it to Spinella. He then lures Spinella into a private meeting and provokes him into a punch, which ends the strike. He also sells Russo to the party chair, makes AA a condition of his support, and has Meechum reinstated.

house-of-cards:S01E07.title: Chapter 7
house-of-cards:S01E07.summary: The President signs the education bill and credits Frank, which gives him new standing at the White House. Vice President Jim Matthews resents being cut out of the Pennsylvania governor's race, and Frank's campaign team for Russo builds a redemption story around his addictions. Doug interrogates Russo about every vice in his past, Russo gets cold feet, and Frank brings back Russo's ex-girlfriend Christina as deputy campaign manager to steady him. When the President and Linda question Russo, Frank tells them about his drug history before anyone else can, and uses the credit from the education bill to win their backing. Doug deals with Rachel, the sex worker from Russo's arrest, by hiding her at Nancy's house. Zoe, following Frank's advice about generosity, helps her former rival Janine Skorsky move to Slugline.

house-of-cards:S01E08.title: Chapter 8
house-of-cards:S01E08.summary: Frank returns to his military college, the Sentinel, for the dedication of a library that carries his name, funded by Sancorp as a favour. Remy Danton, now Sancorp's lobbyist, uses the weekend to signal that his client dislikes Peter Russo's run for governor and his watershed bill, and makes a pass at Claire at her hotel. Frank spends the night with old classmates and a former intimate, Tim Corbet, and gives an unscripted, reflective speech. In Philadelphia, Russo faces the laid-off shipbuilders he failed, is told off by union leader Paul Capra, then forces his way into Paul's house and wins the room the next day by telling them bluntly that he is all they have.

house-of-cards:S01E09.title: Chapter 9
house-of-cards:S01E09.summary: Frank whips the watershed bill, a key credential for Russo's campaign, while Remy Danton peels off Democrats with drilling-industry campaign money. Russo tours Pennsylvania with a hostile Vice President Jim Matthews and wins his endorsement by appealing to his pride. Frank intimidates two liberal holdouts and sends Claire to finish them off, but Claire, who needs Remy's help to free her charity's water filters from South Sudan, quietly tells them it would be fine to vote no. Frank freezes Zoe out after she ends their sexual relationship until she comes back, Doug Stamper pressures a restaurant manager on behalf of Rachel Posner, and Frank sends Linda Vasquez to Stanford for her son. The bill fails on the floor.

house-of-cards:S01E10.title: Chapter 10
house-of-cards:S01E10.summary: Frank takes the blame for the failed vote in front of President Walker to shield Linda, then discovers Claire sold the bill out to Remy, and the two have their worst fight yet; Claire leaves for New York and her former lover Adam Galloway. Russo threatens to expose the Kapeniak affair unless Frank fixes his campaign, so Frank and Doug bring forward their plan to destroy him. Frank hands Russo a lifeline (a pro-drilling pivot brokered with Remy and Sancorp, to be announced on morning radio), while Doug sends Rachel to seduce Russo and get him drinking the night before. Russo gives a drunk, incoherent interview, Zoe breaks the story, and Frank moves to bring Matthews forward. Frank also secretly gets Linda's son into Stanford through Claire's employee Gillian Cole.

house-of-cards:S01E11.title: Chapter 11
house-of-cards:S01E11.summary: With Russo finished, Frank persuades Vice President Matthews to resign and run for his old job as Pennsylvania governor, then sells the same idea to President Walker, feeding each man the other's supposed contempt. Linda confronts Frank about his motives, and he admits he wants the vice presidency and that he helped her son hoping she would return the favour. Russo tries to take real responsibility by turning himself in to police for his old drunk-driving arrest; Doug and the police commissioner bury it, and Frank drives Russo home, gives him drink and kills him, staging it as suicide. Zoe visits Frank's house and wears Claire's dress, and they agree to simplify their arrangement. Walker and Matthews agree to the plan, and Frank delivers a public tribute to Russo.

house-of-cards:S01E12.title: Chapter 12
house-of-cards:S01E12.summary: With Matthews headed for a win in Pennsylvania, Frank and Linda prepare to plant Frank's name for vice president, but Walker announces he wants billionaire Raymond Tusk. Frank volunteers to go to St. Louis to persuade Tusk, researches him through an investigator, and discovers Tusk and Walker are close; Tusk reveals he is actually vetting Frank and asks for an unspecified future favour as the price of his recommendation. Janine Skorsky starts investigating Russo's role in the shipyard closing and pulls Zoe in, and they trace the Kapeniak story back to a visit by Russo. Claire forces Gillian Cole out of her charity after Gillian resists a Sancorp film crew. Frank plans to pressure Tusk by threatening his nuclear holdings through Sancorp.

house-of-cards:S01E13.title: Chapter 13
house-of-cards:S01E13.summary: Frank asks Remy to have Sancorp attack Tusk's nuclear suppliers, then goes around Remy to Sancorp's CEO, who refuses to hear it. Tusk counters by buying Sancorp stock and hiring Remy, and in a final meeting Frank refuses Tusk's blank check and offers loyalty in exchange for loyalty; Tusk then tells Walker to give Frank the vice presidency. Frank leaks the President's off-the-record schedule to stoke pressure, with a scheduler fired as cover. Gillian sues Claire for pregnancy discrimination and refuses any settlement, Claire quietly explores having a child, and Zoe, Janine and Lucas trace Rachel Posner and work out that Frank engineered Russo's collapse to reach the vice presidency. Doug starts closing in on the loose ends as Christina tells him what Zoe knows.

house-of-cards:S02E01.title: Chapter 14
house-of-cards:S02E01.summary: Frank is about to be named Vice President and has two jobs: tie off the loose ends from Season 1 and choose who replaces him as Majority Whip. He persuades the President to leave the whip race open and neutral, and in private recruits third-term congresswoman Jackie Sharp, handing her his files on the two front-runners, Webb and Buchwalter. Doug moves Rachel Posner to a safe house in Joppa, Maryland, as Zoe, Lucas and Janine close in on Russo's arrest and death. Claire gives up on settling with Gillian Cole: she cuts off Gillian's health insurance, then offers her the CWI if she drops the suit. Zoe keeps pressing Frank about Rachel and Russo and dies on the tracks at Cathedral Heights metro station. Police rule it an accident, Janine flees Washington, and Frank's closing monologue ('hunt or be hunted') makes clear he removed her.

house-of-cards:S02E02.title: Chapter 15
house-of-cards:S02E02.summary: Frank is sworn in privately as Vice President. Jackie's whip campaign, funded by Ted Havemeyer's PAC and helped by proxies who leak dirt, turns Webb and Buchwalter against each other. Buchwalter's price for dropping out is Havemeyer's political destruction, and Jackie pays it by leaking that Havemeyer has a secret daughter. Frank nudges Secretary of State Durant into forcing the cyber-attack issue on China, against Tusk's advice to use a soft touch. After backing Tusk in the room, Frank privately stiffens the President, who then backs Durant in public and defies Tusk. Claire tells Frank that General McGinnis, whom Frank must decorate, raped her in college. Lucas tries and fails to get Zoe's death reopened, then learns about the Deep Web from a colleague.

house-of-cards:S02E03.title: Chapter 16
house-of-cards:S02E03.summary: To avoid a government shutdown right before the State of the Union, Frank offers the Republicans the retirement-age increase they have wanted for decades. He negotiates it with Majority Leader Mendoza and Tea Party senator Curtis Haas. When Haas gets cold feet and the Republicans walk out to deny a quorum, Frank, presiding over the Senate, has the absent senators compelled to attend. He then uses a pre-agreed rule that passing the amendment counts as passing the bill, which blocks Haas's filibuster. Doug learns Lucas is digging and gets an FBI contact to go after the anonymous Deep Web poster, while Lucas makes contact with a hacker who owns a guinea pig called Cashew. Claire interviews Connor Ellis as communications director, the Underwoods notice how close the President and Christina seem, and Rachel, isolated in hiding, is invited to church.

house-of-cards:S02E04.title: Chapter 17
house-of-cards:S02E04.summary: The entitlement package needs House votes. Frank works on progressive holdout Donald Blythe and ends up quarantined with him in Jackie's office after a white-powder scare. Blythe turns down every approach, including Alzheimer's research funding linked to his wife's illness. Jackie, prodded by Remy Danton, whips the remaining waverers, and Frank has stacks of paper printed with the names of people a shutdown would hurt so Jackie can put them in front of Blythe. Claire does the planned network interview alone, admits an abortion live on air and frames it as the result of a rape by General McGinnis, and a young private phones in with her own allegation. Lucas, now working with the hacker Gavin, does not know that Gavin is an FBI informant.

house-of-cards:S02E05.title: Chapter 18
house-of-cards:S02E05.summary: Frank attends a Civil War re-enactment in Spotsylvania as cover for a secret back channel with Xander Feng, Tusk's Chinese business partner, ahead of a US-China summit. Feng asks the US to keep its currency lawsuit going and ties this to a bridge project the President wants. Frank leaks that the suit is being dropped, keeps Feng's message from the President and lets the talks sour, then meets Feng secretly against the President's orders. When Tusk accuses him of sabotage, Frank turns it into a question of Tusk's loyalty. The President pulls out of the talks and hangs up on Tusk for the first time in 20 years. Seth Grayson gets hold of the late doctor's journal recording the date of Claire's abortion and uses it to win a job with the Underwoods, while Doug coerces Gavin into delivering Lucas, who is arrested inside a data center.

house-of-cards:S02E06.title: Chapter 19
house-of-cards:S02E06.summary: Chinese retaliation causes an energy crisis driven by samarium prices. Frank persuades the President to buy samarium through India and pass it on to nuclear operators at a discount, which cuts into Tusk's profits. He then escalates: first an antitrust threat, then a FERC investigation, and finally the threatened seizure of Tusk's power plants after Tusk's companies cause blackouts. Lucas refuses a plea deal until Tom Hammerschmidt has interviewed Frank, who dismisses the story. The FBI then pressures Janine into disowning Lucas, and he takes the plea. Claire plants doubts about Christina in Tricia Walker's mind while pushing Christina to be over-familiar. Jackie sleeps with Remy after passing him the antitrust threat, and Doug keeps Rachel on a tight leash.

house-of-cards:S02E07.title: Chapter 20
house-of-cards:S02E07.summary: About 25 million dollars of attack ads hit the Democrats before the midterms, and the President blames Frank. Doug traces the money through casino owner Daniel Lanagin to Feng and Tusk, and Frank decides it is a trap he should keep from the President. Frank's attempt to win Lanagin back fails. Feng tells Doug the price for stopping the money is the Port Jefferson bridge. Frank repairs his standing with the President with a punching-bag gift, late-night talks and a dinner at which Claire advises Tricia about her marriage. Frank also finds out that Remy hired Seth Grayson to dig up dirt, and keeps Seth on as a double agent. Connor leaves for a well-paid private job.

house-of-cards:S02E08.title: Chapter 21
house-of-cards:S02E08.summary: Frank needs the Port Jefferson Bridge approved because it is his price for getting Xander Feng to cut off the Chinese money flowing through Daniel Lanagin's casino to Republican super PACs. Linda Vasquez blocks him, so he goes around her to President Walker, hints that the bridge touches matters the President should not know about, and wins. Tusk and Lanagin counter by re-enrolling the Ugaya tribe that Frank was using as a threat, but Frank closes his deal with Feng anyway, and Feng adds a demand that he kill his refinery venture with Tusk. Linda offers her resignation to force the President to back her, and Frank quietly convinces Walker that refusing it would show he can be leveraged, so she is gone. Meanwhile Remy recruits Claire's embittered former employee Evelyn and someone buys the paintings of Adam Galloway's assistant, and Claire's attempt to put Megan Hennessy in front of Congress collapses when Megan panics and pulls out.

house-of-cards:S02E09.title: Chapter 22
house-of-cards:S02E09.summary: The DC Daily publishes a photograph of Claire in Adam Galloway's bed, planted by Tusk's side. Claire has Adam deny everything and then publicly tells a different story (that it was a portrait commissioned for Frank) so the two accounts do not look coordinated, and Seth stages a recreation with a model to suggest the photo could be faked. Remy has leverage on Adam through his fiancee's father, who faces a rigged treason trial in Colombia, so Frank gets the Secretary of State to have the charges dropped and Claire forces Adam to call the whole thing a publicity stunt. Tusk also leaks Freddy Hayes's criminal past, which destroys Freddy's franchise deal and forces Frank to cut his friend loose. Tusk tries to intimidate the reporter Ayla Sayyad, who is starting to connect him to Feng, and Frank vows to make Tusk suffer.

house-of-cards:S02E10.title: Chapter 23
house-of-cards:S02E10.summary: With China and Japan in a naval standoff and a man arrested outside the Underwood house with explosives meant for Claire, Frank decides to go on the offensive and leak the casino money story through Ayla Sayyad in a way that cannot be traced back to him. Ayla pieces the story together from limousine bookings and flight records and publishes it to coincide with Walker's press conference, which turns the scandal toward the White House. Jackie Sharp refuses to cosponsor Claire's sexual assault bill, Frank's attempt to bully her fails, and he retaliates by telling her that Remy works for Tusk. Walker, cornered, considers a special prosecutor, and Frank gets him to choose one by arguing against it. Tusk orders Remy to go after the Democratic leadership so they turn on Frank.

house-of-cards:S02E11.title: Chapter 24
house-of-cards:S02E11.summary: Special prosecutor Heather Dunbar questions Frank and produces casino security footage of Doug on the day he went to meet Lanagin, a tip that came from Remy. Frank takes responsibility for sending Doug, calls it fact-finding he kept quiet to protect the President, and volunteers his travel logs, then persuades Walker to hand over his own logs, which contain the secret marriage counseling visits. Remy tries to blackmail Jackie into lying to Dunbar and she calls his bluff, and then Remy offers Frank a deal of partial neutrality. Claire brings Megan Hennessy back as the public face of the bill, and Megan attacks Jackie in the New York Times. Frank gives Doug a third chance, and Doug brings Seth into his inner circle while watching him.

house-of-cards:S02E12.title: Chapter 25
house-of-cards:S02E12.summary: Dunbar finds the counseling visits in Walker's logs, and Walker accuses Frank of setting him up and cuts him off completely. Frank and Claire then work several fronts at once: Frank pushes Secretary of State Durant to offer Feng asylum in exchange for testimony, Claire withdraws her bill and makes peace with Jackie while quietly reminding Tricia that she knows about the medication prescribed through the counselor, and Seth tells Tusk that Remy met Frank, which ends Remy's job. Fearing a leak, the Walkers waive privilege, the White House counsel is accused of coaching the counselor, and impeachment talk begins. Frank publicly defends the President to Ayla Sayyad, and privately he and Claire ask Jackie to whip votes for impeachment.

house-of-cards:S02E13.title: Chapter 26
house-of-cards:S02E13.summary: Walker sends Linda Vasquez to offer Tusk a pardon if he testifies that Frank ran the money scheme. Frank predicts the move and outbids it by arguing to Tusk that Walker is a failing asset and that he can end the China standoff. He then sends Walker a letter containing a signed false confession, which wins back enough trust that Walker cancels the pardon deal, and at the hearing Tusk testifies that the President knew. Jackie whips the impeachment votes, Frank dangles a cabinet post in front of Walker's enemy Michael Kern, the Judiciary Committee recommends impeachment, and Walker resigns. Frank is sworn in, ends the naval standoff at once, and sends Feng back to China, while Doug, who went to deal with Rachel Posner after the hacker Gavin threatened him with her, has vanished.

house-of-cards:S03E01.title: Chapter 27
house-of-cards:S03E01.summary: Six months into his unelected presidency, Frank Underwood has terrible approval ratings, a hostile Congress and a stalled jobs program, America Works. He fires an economic adviser who waters the plan down, and persuades Justice Jacobs, newly diagnosed with Alzheimer's, to delay retirement so a Supreme Court fight does not collide with America Works. Doug Stamper, recovering from Rachel's attack, begs to come back and is gently kept at arm's length; he pressures the hacker Gavin Orsay to find Rachel, and Gavin demands help leaving the FBI in return. Claire lines up her nomination as UN Ambassador and courts Republican front-runner Hector Mendoza, then forces Frank to announce it when he wavers. The episode ends with Frank authorising a drone strike that may kill children, with Claire watching.

house-of-cards:S03E02.title: Chapter 28
house-of-cards:S03E02.summary: Claire's confirmation hearing turns when Senator Mendoza provokes her into an angry exchange over a clipped quote about the military, and the Senate rejects her 52 to 48. The Democratic leadership (Birch, Womack and Jackie Sharp) tells Frank they will not back him in 2016; he fails to break them one by one or to raise money around them. He then turns their demand into a trade: he will publicly renounce a 2016 run if they introduce America Works, and delivers a televised 'You are entitled to nothing' speech. Jackie leaks the short leadership meeting to a reporter to make herself indispensable and pushes Remy for the vice presidency. Frank tells the Solicitor General, Heather Dunbar, to admit the drone strike in court, and Claire demands and gets a recess appointment to the UN.

house-of-cards:S03E03.title: Chapter 29
house-of-cards:S03E03.summary: Russian President Viktor Petrov visits Washington for a summit on a joint US and Russian peacekeeping force in the Jordan Valley. Petrov opens with a flat no, refuses to name his price, flirts with and kisses Claire, and finally demands the removal of the entire US missile defence system in Europe. Frank offers a partial, secret scale-back; Petrov insists it be announced, then walks away and cancels the joint press conference. Frank recasts the collapse publicly as standing up to Petrov, while Claire and Secretary of State Cathy Durant propose using the UN's Uniting for Peace procedure to bypass Russia's Security Council veto. Doug turns down a lucrative job he suspects Frank arranged, and trades Gavin a lifted passport lock for Rachel's exact location after the FBI takes away Gavin's backup leverage.

house-of-cards:S03E04.title: Chapter 30
house-of-cards:S03E04.summary: Heather Dunbar wins praise for her drone-strike argument before the Supreme Court, and Frank, fearing she will run for president, offers her Justice Jacobs' seat. Jacobs has decided to stay on the bench, so Frank pressures him with the threat that a leak about his Alzheimer's would undo his life's work; Jacobs is close to Dunbar and tells her, and she announces her candidacy instead. Russia arrests the American gay rights activist Michael Corrigan, apparently as leverage against Claire's UN resolution, and Claire urges Frank not to trade. Seth Grayson strips reporter Ayla Sayyad of her White House credential by lifting a press moratorium for everyone except her. Gavin befriends Rachel's friend Lisa under a false identity, and Doug offers his services and files to Dunbar.

house-of-cards:S03E05.title: Chapter 31
house-of-cards:S03E05.summary: Frank declares unemployment an emergency under the Stafford Act, diverts FEMA disaster money into America Works starting in Washington DC with a mayor who owes him, forces out the Homeland Security Secretary who objects, and opens a registration tent on the Mall on the Fourth of July. Congressional leaders threaten impeachment; Frank reminds them that the alternative is Vice President Blythe. He recruits Jackie to run a staged primary campaign against him to split Dunbar's support, and Jackie decides to marry Alan Cooke for the campaign image. Seth's expulsion of Ayla backfires when her paper sends the tougher Kate Baldwin, who publishes leaked FEMA projections. Claire, whose bluff about US troops was called by the Russian ambassador, gets Frank to sign an executive order committing 5,000 troops and forces Petrov back to talks, securing an invitation to Moscow and Corrigan's release. Doug negotiates a paid role with Dunbar and shows her a document about Claire's abortion, and Frank hires novelist Thomas Yates to write a book about America Works.

house-of-cards:S03E06.title: Chapter 32
house-of-cards:S03E06.summary: The Underwoods fly to Moscow to sign a Jordan Valley deal and bring Corrigan home, but Petrov requires Corrigan to read a scripted apology praising him. Corrigan refuses, Claire spends the night in his cell trying to persuade him, and Petrov suspects Claire of sabotage after she has the bug removed. Frank works Petrov into a full deal, including removal of missiles from the Czech Republic, and Petrov agrees on condition of the statement. Corrigan hangs himself with Claire's scarf; at the press conference Claire departs from the script, blames Russia's law and says 'Shame on you, Mr. President', and the deal collapses. Meanwhile Doug coaches Dunbar's team on winning a superdelegate, and Gavin fakes an HIV scare to deepen Lisa's trust and learns Rachel's dream destination in New Mexico.

house-of-cards:S03E07.title: Chapter 33
house-of-cards:S03E07.summary: The Underwoods' marriage is strained after Moscow; Frank publicly slaps down a Zimbabwe aid proposal from Claire in a cabinet meeting, and she accuses him of punishing her. Congress moves to outlaw the FEMA diversion, and Frank plans to veto and refuse to enforce so that the fight is over real jobs, using the Social Security anniversary to say the dead should not govern the living. Thomas Yates presses Frank for honesty and gets it only after confessing his own career-defining secret. Dunbar's team plans legislation to force Jackie to take sides, and Gavin shows Doug photos of Rachel in Santa Fe while Doug holds back the passport. Frank reverses himself and approves an 80 million dollar aid package so Claire can outbid Israel's secret payment to Zimbabwe and demand Israel's support for the resolution.

house-of-cards:S03E08.title: Chapter 34
house-of-cards:S03E08.summary: Hurricane Faith heads for the East Coast and the Disaster Relief Fund has been drained by Frank's raid for America Works. The new Senate Majority Leader, Henry Mitchell, offers ten billion dollars on condition that no agency money can ever fund AmWorks again, and he has the votes to override a veto. Frank stalls, hoping the storm turns, while seven governors and Jackie Sharp, his secretly allied primary challenger and intended running mate, turn on him; Heather Dunbar talks Jackie into jointly suspending their campaigns, and Doug Stamper, secretly working for Dunbar, leaks that meeting to the White House through Seth. Frank finally signs the bill, the hurricane veers out to sea, and America Works is dead. He turns the defeat into a launch: he announces his candidacy for 2016 on the platform that a vote for him is a vote for America Works.

house-of-cards:S03E09.title: Chapter 35
house-of-cards:S03E09.summary: An IED kills eight Russian peacekeepers in the Jordan Valley and Petrov seals off the blast site. Russian UN ambassador Moryakov meets Claire in a UN restroom and hints that Petrov's own FSB staged the attack; Frank gambles on a 12-hour covert SEAL insertion to collect proof, but the local agent is rogue and a SEAL is killed. Frank leaks the firefight footage to the Israelis to squeeze Petrov, and Israeli troops then move into the valley. Meanwhile Gavin Orsay shows Doug forged proof that Rachel is dead to get his passport lock lifted; Doug relapses, confesses to Frank that he has been working for Dunbar 'for him', and Frank phones Dunbar with a threat. Frank also ferries Iowa power broker Harlan Traub on Air Force One and has to parry an FEC question at a briefing.

house-of-cards:S03E10.title: Chapter 36
house-of-cards:S03E10.summary: The Jordan Valley unravels: Israel declares a no-fly zone, Petrov announces he will fly in anyway, and Moryakov is recalled. Against Claire's warning that going in person hands Petrov the leverage, Frank flies to a Russian camp in the valley. Petrov demands the end of the peacekeeping mission, the missile-defence scale-back and, as a non-negotiable condition, Claire's removal as UN ambassador, and he reveals that Moryakov's hints were a manipulation that goaded the SEAL raid. Frank agrees, Claire resigns under a cover story, and the Russians withdraw. Tom Yates works both Underwoods for the book, trading his own secrets for Frank's and using Frank's confidences to get Claire to open up.

house-of-cards:S03E11.title: Chapter 37
house-of-cards:S03E11.summary: The first Democratic debate in Iowa. Frank's team settles on the word 'vision' and sets up Jackie Sharp as his attack dog on Dunbar's inherited wealth and private-school children, while Frank stays presidential. Jackie secretly sounds out Dunbar for a better deal, but Dunbar offers her nothing. On stage Jackie's attacks land but rebound on her when Dunbar exposes that Jackie's own stepchildren attend private school; Frank wins the post-debate polls. When Jackie complains about being kept on a leash, Frank tells her this is not a partnership of equals, ignores Remy's warning about loyalty, and within days Jackie drops out and endorses Dunbar. Gavin, now free, reveals Rachel is alive and trades her location for a deal for his friend, and Claire faints giving blood after confiding in Yates.

house-of-cards:S03E12.title: Chapter 38
house-of-cards:S03E12.summary: Dunbar leads by six in Iowa and Claire becomes the campaign's main asset. Dying Justice Jacobs asks Dunbar to take his Supreme Court seat and she refuses, admitting she wants the presidency. Dunbar's team, hunting for dirt on Claire, tries to buy Claire's journal (proof she lied about an abortion) from Doug, and Dunbar then tells Frank in the Oval Office she has it and gives him three days to withdraw. Doug burns the page in front of Frank, reframes his dealings as loyalty and demands the Chief of Staff job, which Frank gives him over Claire's objection. Frank kills Yates's marriage-focused book and threatens him, Kate Baldwin publishes a story on the SEAL's death, and Claire tells Frank they have been lying to each other.

house-of-cards:S03E13.title: Chapter 39
house-of-cards:S03E13.summary: In the final days before the Iowa caucus Claire campaigns hard for Frank, and Frank wins Iowa narrowly, but the marriage fractures behind the scenes. Doug tracks Gavin to Caracas, extracts Rachel's location under threat, and abducts Rachel in New Mexico, where she pleads for her life by insisting that Rachel is already dead and she is now Cassie Lockhart. Claire stays in Washington, meets Yates to learn what she said to him, and skips the victory speech. In the Oval Office she tells Frank that their partnership has only ever made him stronger; he answers that the office has one chair and orders her onto the plane to New Hampshire. She tells him she is leaving him.

house-of-cards:S04E01.title: Chapter 40
house-of-cards:S04E01.summary: Claire has left Frank and gone to her mother Elizabeth's ranch in Dallas, so Frank campaigns in New Hampshire alone and has to explain where she is. Claire quietly hires Texas Democratic consultant LeAnn Harvey to run her for Congress in the 30th district, a seat held by Doris Jones that her daughter Celia expects to inherit. Frank sends Doug Stamper to Texas and threatens LeAnn by phone, and Doug briefs Doris before Claire does, so Claire's pitch falls apart in the room. Someone in the White House leaks a story about the marriage on the eve of the primary. Frank flies to Dallas and makes Claire hold a press conference using her mother's lymphoma as the cover story, promising to leave her alone if she attends the State of the Union. Seth Grayson meets Dunbar's campaign in secret and agrees to feed them information. In prison, Lucas Goodwin gets his cellmate Gagik to reveal who he took the fall for and trades that to the FBI for early release into witness protection. Frank loses New Hampshire to Heather Dunbar.

house-of-cards:S04E02.title: Chapter 41
house-of-cards:S04E02.summary: Elizabeth Hale persuades her wealthy friends to fund Heather Dunbar through indirect donations so that Frank loses and Claire is free. Claire and LeAnn put together a side deal: a $3 million super PAC for Jackie Sharp's tight California race if Jackie pushes the Joneses' breast cancer clinic through Congress, with LeAnn photographing Jackie's hotel meetings with Remy Danton as backup. Remy notices the Texas money and presses LeAnn, who warns him off by hinting she knows about the affair. In the State of the Union, Frank announces federal backing for Doris's clinic and endorses Celia for the seat on live television, which kills Claire's race. Frank refuses to hand the dissident oligarch Igor Milkin back to Petrov without terms. Claire decides to 'think bigger' and threatens to sell her mother's land to pay LeAnn.

house-of-cards:S04E03.title: Chapter 42
house-of-cards:S04E03.summary: Before the South Carolina primary, Frank campaigns in his hometown of Gaffney and he and Claire seem to reconcile. On primary morning a billboard shows Frank's father standing beside a Klansman. Claire set this up through LeAnn and Oren Chase, a local politician who hates Frank. Frank admits in church that it is his father and gives the backstory, then has Chase confess on camera that an unnamed brunette paid him, so suspicion falls on Dunbar, but a second leaked photo sinks him and he loses his home state. Lucas Goodwin tracks down Dunbar with his accusations but has no proof and is thrown out. Frank decides to frighten Petrov by making Milkin look like a real coup threat. Claire admits she was behind the billboard and demands to be his running mate; Frank refuses and she leaves for Dallas.

house-of-cards:S04E04.title: Chapter 43
house-of-cards:S04E04.summary: Polling shows the public rejects Claire as vice president, so Frank and Doug try to win over LeAnn by offering her the campaign manager job. LeAnn stays loyal and hands Frank Claire's ultimatum: a divorce announcement she has already written. Frank has the Secret Service shut Claire inside the Dallas house under a 'credible threat'. Seth, suspected as the leaker, gets Dunbar's campaign manager to tell him about Lucas Goodwin. Dunbar asks the Attorney General to look into abuse of power, and the AG refuses. At a campaign stop Frank goes out to talk to protesters and Lucas shoots him; Meechum kills Lucas and dies. Blythe becomes acting president, and Claire, back in Washington, gets him to divert Milkin's plane to China against Frank's plan.

house-of-cards:S04E05.title: Chapter 44
house-of-cards:S04E05.summary: Frank's liver is failing and he needs a transplant. Claire secretly listens to acting president Blythe's call with Petrov, who humiliates Blythe until he gives away Frank's condition. Doug fires the Attorney General over the witness protection failure and confronts Seth about the leaked re-enactor photo. Seth saves his job by revealing that Dunbar met Goodwin, and Doug uses that to keep the AG in office in exchange for her testimony. Claire holds a press conference that dismisses Goodwin's notes as the words of a sick man, and in the same briefing the FBI says it will question Dunbar. Claire becomes close to Blythe, pushes Remy to bring Raymond Tusk into a Russia energy deal, and Remy squeezes Tusk with a perjury threat. Doug offers his own liver.

house-of-cards:S04E06.title: Chapter 45
house-of-cards:S04E06.summary: Tusk's plan has China, the IMF and a US-Chinese energy consortium fund a Russian bailout in exchange for Siberian drilling rights. Doug forces the Health Secretary to move Frank up the transplant list, and the man who is bumped dies. Remy tells Jackie that Claire has photos of their affair, Jackie drops her opposition, and House leader Bob Birch schedules the vote. Claire gets onto the G7 delegation over Cathy Durant's objection, keeps flying while Frank is in surgery, and closes the deal with Petrov one on one. Under questioning, Dunbar admits she met Goodwin and uses the room to attack a president who is on the operating table, which finishes her campaign. LeAnn learns that Conway is working with the search engine Pollyhop. Frank wakes up, and Claire tells him she will come back only as an equal partner.

house-of-cards:S04E07.title: Chapter 46
house-of-cards:S04E07.summary: Dunbar drops out, which makes Frank the presumptive nominee, and the fight turns to Republican Will Conway. Frank will not strike ICO leaders in Syria, while his lawyers ask the FISA court for domestic surveillance on the grounds that ICO is a threat. Frank's Plan A is to expose Conway's Pollyhop data deal through a reporter nobody credentialed. His Plan B is NSA-fed voter targeting, and Doug and LeAnn recruit data scientist Aidan Macallan for it. General Brockhart threatens to resign and leaks to Conway, so Frank agrees to the strike to keep him. Claire takes on the NRA over gun reform, and she and Frank rehearse and run a good cop, bad cop routine on party leaders over the running mate. Conway defuses Pollyhop with a transparency webcast, and Frank aborts the strike to keep Plan B alive. A flashback shows Frank and Claire meeting the Conways in 2012.

house-of-cards:S04E08.title: Chapter 47
house-of-cards:S04E08.summary: Will and Hannah Conway fly novelist Tom Yates to their home and offer him a Vanity Fair cover and a literary comeback if he publishes his damaging Underwood novel before the election; Yates uses the offer to force a meeting with the Underwoods, who hire him as a speechwriter instead. Frank accepts the party leadership's pick for running mate, Senator Dean Austen of Ohio, only in exchange for the leadership moving Claire's gun bill, while Claire's personal robocall floods Congress with calls. Frank then pushes Austen to publicly endorse the bill and Claire secretly offers NRA lobbyist Julia Melman a deal: the bill dies in the Senate if she makes Austen withdraw, which he does. With Austen gone, Frank proposes an open convention so the party appears to choose Cathy Durant. Conway recruits the Joint Chiefs chairman, General Brockhart, as his running mate and gives Vanity Fair the exclusive on his resignation. Tom Hammerschmidt keeps digging into Zoe Barnes and learns that Meechum used to visit her neighborhood, and Doug orders Seth to find dirt on campaign manager LeAnn Harvey.

house-of-cards:S04E09.title: Chapter 48
house-of-cards:S04E09.summary: The open convention opens in Atlanta. While the Underwoods publicly endorse Cathy Durant, Senator Sheer casts a single vote for Claire, Texas hands her all 237 of its delegates, and a story that Claire, not Cathy, closed the Brandenburg deal with Petrov spreads through the press. Frank feigns loyalty to rival candidate Senator Baker, lets him ask what is in it for him, and promises him Cathy's job as Secretary of State if he swings his delegates to Claire. Conway crashes the convention demanding an apology to Brockhart; Frank apologizes, invites him in, and the two spend the next ballot in a back room trading barbs while Frank tries to have Conway's calls intercepted. Claire surges to second, but Cathy's home state of Louisiana casts its votes for her for President as a warning, and Cathy stops taking Frank's calls. Claire leaves for Texas and her dying mother so she will not look like she is campaigning, taking Yates, who has already guessed the plan. Seth tells LeAnn that Doug wants her gone.

house-of-cards:S04E10.title: Chapter 49
house-of-cards:S04E10.summary: Frank uses an ICO advance toward the Euphrates as the reason to fly to Washington with Cathy, keeping her out of Atlanta and off the phone with Conway, and leans on convention chair Patti Whittaker to postpone all votes until they return. Cathy demands Claire's delegates or she will endorse Heather Dunbar, whose allies, including Jackie Sharp, are working the California delegation. Claire briefly loses her nerve and Frank recommits her; in Texas, Claire's mother asks her to arrange her death and Claire does. Frank breaks Cathy with a mix of friendly press, the sympathy wave from Claire's mother's death, and a chilling private confession, and Cathy withdraws and endorses Claire. Claire's speech, which openly admits the strains on her marriage, carries the hall, and the Underwoods are nominated by acclamation. Hammerschmidt shows Dunbar the doctored travel logs and she points him at Remy Danton, while Seth confronts Doug about the campaign against LeAnn.

house-of-cards:S04E11.title: Chapter 50
house-of-cards:S04E11.summary: The Underwood-Underwood ticket trails Conway by double digits and doctors ground Frank, so Claire campaigns in Conway's wake. Frank plans to get the ICO leadership with Russian special forces in exchange for drilling zones, but Conway, fed by allies on the House Intelligence Committee, has the plan blocked to keep ICO alive as an issue until November, so Frank sends in American special forces. Freddy Hayes quits the White House and curses Frank out, then refuses to talk to Hammerschmidt, while Remy Danton confirms the story silently through a drinking game and the Herald gives Hammerschmidt a small, autonomous team. Coached by Yates to stop playing Conway's game, Claire finds a new message about going 'beyond' marriage and politics that Aidan Macallan's data shows is landing. Yates leaves the campaign, Frank meets him calmly and then tells Claire to keep him close, and Doug meets Laura Moretti, the widow of the man whose place on the liver list Doug manipulated.

house-of-cards:S04E12.title: Chapter 51
house-of-cards:S04E12.summary: At a joint debate, Claire presses Conway until he denies on the record that he or the General contacted the House Intelligence Committee, while Doug and Frank pressure Republican Congressman George Walleck to expose the lie. Two American ICO sympathisers kidnap the Miller family and demand to speak only to Conway; Frank publicly announces he is asking Conway for help before telling him, and brings the Conways to stay at the White House. Conway insists on a real role, uses the captors' first names and his own war confession on the call, and wins a deadline extension and a wave of good press. Frank widens Aidan's domestic surveillance program to the FBI, CIA and Homeland Security to find the kidnappers. Hammerschmidt persuades former President Walker to go on the record, Remy and Jackie Sharp decide to join him, and Frank quietly arranges to bring Ahmadi out of Guantanamo.

house-of-cards:S04E13.title: Chapter 52
house-of-cards:S04E13.summary: Frank takes over the hostage call from Conway, trades contact with Ahmadi for the release of the mother and daughter, and sends Conway home just as the Walleck story breaks. Claire negotiates directly with Ahmadi, offering his secular Baathist faction a return to power, but he uses the call to order Jim Miller's execution and the raid finds an empty building. Frank's off-the-record interview with Hammerschmidt fails to stop the Herald story, which runs with Walker, Remy and Jackie quoted, and the surveillance program is taken out of Aidan's hands. Facing likely defeat and investigation, Frank and Claire decide to stop trying to win hearts and to govern through fear: Frank addresses the nation from the Oval Office, declares total war on ICO, refuses to block the execution video, and turns to the camera with Claire.

house-of-cards:S05E01.title: Chapter 53
house-of-cards:S05E01.summary: The election is two weeks away, and Hammerschmidt's Herald article has Republicans pushing to investigate Frank. He hijacks a House session to demand a declaration of war on ICO over the beheading of Jim Miller. Claire runs a fear ad asking citizens to report anything suspicious. At Frank's direction she also turns Masterson's mother, whom Hannah Conway had defended online, from a sympathetic figure into a public plea for her son to surrender. Frank reveals that he has secretly held Masterson all along. Once the prisoner is useless he has him killed on camera and uses the announcement to press Congress. LeAnn persuades Aidan Macallan to use NSA zero-day exploits for the campaign, and Conway's camp recruits Congressman Romero and turns the declaration committee Frank asked for into a way to investigate him.

house-of-cards:S05E02.title: Chapter 54
house-of-cards:S05E02.summary: On Halloween Frank convenes an emergency meeting of governors. He signs an executive order expanding the National Guard and pushes 'voting centers', aiming at five swing states. Frank and Doug buy former vice president Jim Matthews' harmless committee testimony with a Superfund designation for a Pennsylvania slag heap. When NSA auditors threaten to expose Aidan, Frank lets him stage a cyberattack on a DC telecom switching center and has the fix held back. He blames the outage on ICO, and the stranded Ohio governor accepts troops. Seth quietly offers the committee private testimony about Doug, and Claire learns from Ken Caswell that Frank's old friend Tim Corbet has gone missing.

house-of-cards:S05E03.title: Chapter 55
house-of-cards:S05E03.summary: On election eve Conway holds a 24-hour livestream. The Underwoods plant callers, and LeAnn gets Craig Squire, the soldier Conway rescued, on the line to hint at something Conway heard. Mark Usher, newly on Conway's campaign, turns the damage into ad footage. Doug catches Matthews lying about troops but pushes too hard. Durant brings Frank a Syrian national who shares an ICO operative's name, as an option to arrest. Late at night Frank calls into the livestream and frames Conway's hostage negotiation as proof the enemy saw him as weak. On election day turnout collapses on both sides, including Frank's base, and Pennsylvania looks lost.

house-of-cards:S05E04.title: Chapter 56
house-of-cards:S05E04.summary: On election day the FBI raids Muhammed Kalabi's Knoxville apartment. After an incident at a voting center, the Republican governor imposes a curfew and suspends voting, which moves Tennessee to undecided. Doug forces Aidan to fabricate NSA chatter and uses it to get Ohio's Democratic governor to close polls in three Republican counties. When Pennsylvania goes to Conway, Frank concedes privately by phone but never publicly. Ohio stays shut, lawsuits multiply and several states refuse to certify. The episode ends with Frank telling the camera that the American people need him to tell them what to think.

house-of-cards:S05E05.title: Chapter 57
house-of-cards:S05E05.summary: Nine weeks later neither candidate has 270 electoral votes. Under the Twelfth Amendment the House, voting one vote per state, picks the president, and the Senate picks the vice president. Frank summons Romero and offers him access in exchange for three delegations, but Romero does not deliver. Doug works the phones with kompromat while LeAnn wins Maine through a personal favor. The result is a House deadlock that denies Conway the 26 states he needs. Claire courts women senators by separating herself from Frank. Blythe tries to stall the Senate, but after the House deadlocks the Senate elects Claire vice president, which makes her acting president.

house-of-cards:S05E06.title: Chapter 58
house-of-cards:S05E06.summary: Claire is sworn in as acting president, and Russia uses the chaos to land troops in Antarctica. Frank fails to win back Congressman Rasmussen, and Conway is humiliated by the Congressional Black Caucus, then melts down on his plane. Claire pushes for a revote in Tennessee and Ohio and makes a deal with Usher. She will step down after the revote, both full tickets will run again, and she will recess-appoint Usher's Supreme Court pick. Doug secretly pays a ransom for Aidan, but Petrov reveals that he holds Aidan in the Kremlin and uses him as leverage for Antarctic oil. Frank tells Claire the deal was not hers to make, and the partnership shows strain.

house-of-cards:S05E07.title: Chapter 59
house-of-cards:S05E07.summary: Frank objects to the Usher deal and to the Supreme Court pick Claire has promised. A missing truck of cesium sends the Underwoods to the bunker, and General Braegher pushes to evacuate DC. Frank suspects Brockhart's military allies are staging a coup to cost them the revote. Jane Davis, a commerce official, uses the crisis to get close to Claire and hints that she can deliver the ICO leader Ahmadi. The truck turns out to be misparked, and Braegher is forced to resign. LeAnn obtains a hot-mic clip of Brockhart saying soldiers should put the president 'out of his misery', which Frank plays for Usher, while Hammerschmidt ties Doug to Rachel Posner's apartment.

house-of-cards:S05E08.title: Chapter 60
house-of-cards:S05E08.summary: With the contested election reduced to a revote in Ohio and Tennessee, Frank bargains his way into Elysian Fields, a secretive retreat for the country's most powerful men, where Raymond Tusk has invited Conway's running mate General Brockhart instead of Conway. Frank shows unexpected restraint, tells Doug to do nothing about Tusk's Pollyhop deal, and pitches himself to the room as the man who sells America a tangible tomorrow. In Washington, acting President Claire uses a sinking Russian research vessel, and China's hidden interest in the American aboard, to squeeze a higher tariff out of China before allowing the rescue. Benjamin Grant of Pollyhop hands Frank a recording of Conway threatening a pilot, and the Underwoods bring Mark Usher to the White House, where Frank lays out a partnership and Usher advises releasing the damage slowly. The episode closes with the oppo campaign scripted against Conway and then Brockhart, and Frank's victory treated as settled.

house-of-cards:S05E09.title: Chapter 61
house-of-cards:S05E09.summary: Conway concedes after the Republicans stay quiet, and Frank twists the knife by offering him the Transportation Secretary post. The Underwoods quietly push LeAnn Harvey out through a leak, bring Mark Usher in as special advisor with the aim of managing him while he thinks he manages them, and meet Jane Davis's oil-and-security agenda. Congressman Alex Romero demands two seats on the inaugural dais and a line on Medicare; Frank gives the seats and pointedly withholds the line, sending a message to anyone disloyal, and Romero answers by pushing to restart the Declaration of War Committee. LeAnn tries to protect herself by steering journalist Kate Baldwin to Aidan Macallan in Moscow, which forces the Underwoods and Jane Davis to extract Macallan first. Claire begins an affair with Tom Yates and quietly probes Doug about why he was absent the night of the beheading.

house-of-cards:S05E10.title: Chapter 62
house-of-cards:S05E10.summary: Romero's committee targets Jackie Sharp, and Usher kills her testimony by leaking the story so her lawyers must advise silence. Usher also counsels Romero to keep the committee alive at a slow burn, while Doyle learns Usher had been grooming Romero for a presidential run. Jane Davis tells Frank a gas attack in Homs is coming and suggests a red line that would justify 30,000 troops, and the Underwoods start preparing Cathy Durant to present it at the UN. Usher lines up a university chancellorship for Garrett Walker to plead the Fifth, but after Frank visits Walker against Claire's advice, Walker testifies that Frank was a chief architect of the Chinese money scheme. Meanwhile Macallan escapes the Jordanian Embassy, gets LeAnn's gun, and is later found dead, and Hammerschmidt and Sean Jeffries close in on the liver transplant and Zoe Barnes.

house-of-cards:S05E11.title: Chapter 63
house-of-cards:S05E11.summary: Walker's testimony puts impeachment on the table; Usher and Claire push Frank toward accepting censure, and he refuses and then relents too late. A Slugline leak that the campaign had an innocent Muslim man arrested to sway Tennessee sets off a full surveillance operation inside the White House, which Frank turns on everyone, including Claire, whose 45 missing minutes feed his suspicion. Frank orders Cathy Durant to fabricate a paper trail on the Kalabi arrest and then names her the leak; she negotiates immunity to testify. Doug confesses to Frank that he forced HHS to jump him up the donor list, while Laura Moretti turns on Doug and Claire ends things with Tom Yates. Usher and Claire rehearse her deniability, and Jane Davis urges Claire to be able to walk away from anything that happens to Frank.

house-of-cards:S05E12.title: Chapter 64
house-of-cards:S05E12.summary: Frank fails to talk Cathy out of testifying and she falls down the stairs, delaying the hearing. Usher and Jane Davis work the Senate against Frank on behalf of donors who have moved to Claire, while Jane and Colonel Ismat arrange for a regime gas attack that will justify US troops. Hammerschmidt bluffs, through Sean Jeffries inside the White House, that Zoe Barnes's phone can be read, and the Underwoods ask Doug to take the blame for Zoe's death; Doug complies, and Frank scripts Seth's testimony about Doug. Claire meets Tom Yates over his manuscript and he dies at the private apartment. Frank tells Jane to make him an offer for his silence, then testifies to the Judiciary Committee, accuses the members of being as corrupt as he is, and announces his resignation.

house-of-cards:S05E13.title: Chapter 65
house-of-cards:S05E13.summary: Frank reveals to Claire that his resignation, the leaks to Hammerschmidt and the chaos around them were planned since Elysian Fields: he will wield power from the private sector while she holds the White House, as long as she pardons him. He uses Romero's college scandal to shut the committee down and threatens to withdraw his resignation until Claire promises the pardon. Doug turns himself in for Zoe's murder, Seth is forced out, LeAnn trades Macallan's files for her gun and a promise of Chief of Staff and is then moved aside, and Jane Davis delivers Ahmadi before leaving for Dubai. Claire is sworn in, asks Frank to leave the White House so they appear estranged, announces Ahmadi's death and troops for Syria, and leaves the pardon out of her speech. She ignores Frank's calls and tells the camera it is her turn.

house-of-cards:S06E01.title: Chapter 66
house-of-cards:S06E01.summary: One hundred days into her presidency and newly widowed, Claire Underwood faces a flood of death threats and a Vice President, Mark Usher, who owes his place to the industrialist siblings Bill and Annette Shepherd. The Shepherds want her to sign a deregulation bill and to drop her support for Lieutenant General Nancy Gallagher, and Bill tells her that Francis made them promises. Claire refuses to honour her dead husband's deals, rewrites her Fourth of July speech to attack 'American oligarchs', and a shot is fired at her motorcade on the way back. Doug Stamper, confined to a psychiatric facility after confessing to Zoe Barnes's murder, sticks to his story. Claire tells FBI Assistant Director Nathan Green that she believes Francis was murdered by powerful people and asks him, alone, to investigate.

house-of-cards:S06E02.title: Chapter 67
house-of-cards:S06E02.summary: A chemical leak at the Arcas refinery, a Shepherd subsidiary, gives Claire an opening: she pressures the governor into declaring an emergency, tours Bellport, names the Shepherds in public and moves the EPA's criminal investigators into the Pentagon. Seth Grayson, now working for the Shepherd Freedom Foundation, signs up frightened residents to a data-harvesting app built by Annette's son Duncan. Doug engineers his way out of the facility by threatening to recant and offering the US Attorney a bigger target: Claire. The Shepherds escalate with a ring taken from Francis's grave left on his bed, a break-in at the Gaffney house, and Bill's knowledge of a secret handwritten will; Annette unsettles Claire by telling her she once slept with Francis. Claire reconnects with Doug, tells him Cathy Durant is the one urgent loose end, and agrees to sign the bill under a condition of her own.

house-of-cards:S06E03.title: Chapter 68
house-of-cards:S06E03.summary: Claire tries to peel Mark away from the Shepherds and learns that Bill is ill. Seth recruits ambitious Congressman Brett Cole for the Shepherds' camp by finding what they hold over him, and Duncan, whose company is buying up media outlets, tries to blackmail Tom Hammerschmidt into attacking Claire. Claire brings Jane Davis into the White House, learns about Duncan's sealed juvenile case and uses it to back Annette off during a Supreme Court nomination fight over Judge Abruzzo. When Doug refuses to handle Cathy Durant, Claire asks Jane, who meets Cathy at a restaurant; Cathy is reported dead of an embolism the same night. The episode ends with Mark being shown a body and told he is out of options.

house-of-cards:S06E04.title: Chapter 69
house-of-cards:S06E04.summary: At Cathy's funeral Mark believes he has won control of the presidency, and Claire lets everyone see a compliant, agreeable president while Russian President Viktor Petrov demands talks on Syria. She lets Mark and Seth negotiate, watches Petrov humiliate them, then meets Petrov privately and trades Russia the ports and offshore rights for a 20 percent cut and the exclusion of all Shepherd-linked contractors. Doug, facing a subpoena, negotiates the terms of a pardon, and Seth tells him that Claire is hiding Francis's will from him. A rumour that the missing speechwriter Tom Yates had an affair in the White House is steered onto press secretary Kelsey Stewart. Hammerschmidt and Janine Skorsky start pulling on the Bellport and Rachel Posner threads.

house-of-cards:S06E05.title: Chapter 70
house-of-cards:S06E05.summary: Claire vanishes from public view for three weeks, and a staged photograph and a performed collapse in front of Mark convince the Shepherds that she is unfit. The Shepherds and Mark prepare a 25th Amendment removal by the Cabinet, while Claire coaches Kelsey to tell the FBI that Tom Yates suspected Mark of colluding with Russia. When Duncan pays her an unsanctioned visit offering to erase Francis's memory digitally, Claire tells him to ask his mother where he came from. Annette answers by giving Melody Cruz the story of Claire's 16-week abortion, and Claire tells her to run it. At the Cabinet meeting where the letter is to be signed, Claire fires every member, the FBI news about Mark breaks, and she swears in an all-female Cabinet.

house-of-cards:S06E06.title: Chapter 71
house-of-cards:S06E06.summary: Claire makes a short, final public statement about the abortion and presents her new Cabinet while Mark is left defending himself against the Russia allegations and is abandoned by Annette. Jane returns from captivity, tells Claire the story that broke Mark's nerve years ago (a young woman on Brett Cole's campaign who killed herself after Mark leaned on her), and dies soon after. Doug recovers Francis's will, tips Janine before Seth can seize her Bellport emails, and confesses Rachel Posner's killing to Hammerschmidt, who is then killed in what is reported as a robbery. The emails let the Justice Department arrest Bill Shepherd, and Duncan breaks with Bill after learning he was adopted. Claire tells Doug that her prenuptial agreement gives Francis's estate to his heir and reveals that she is pregnant.

house-of-cards:S06E07.title: Chapter 72
house-of-cards:S06E07.summary: Now heavily pregnant and polling near 80 percent, Claire tours the heartland attacking the oligarchs and the Shepherd app, which has become grounds for charging Duncan with treason. The Shepherds prepare a Supreme Court ruling to strip her of nuclear authority through Justice Abruzzo, and Claire forces Abruzzo to recuse himself using a Shepherd-funded lake house loan and Brett Cole as the messenger. She courts Janine to tell Francis's story on her terms, discusses with Petrov how Russian trolls could amplify Francis's crimes, and on television calls her late husband a con man. The Shepherds privately model the economic cost of her assassination and try to recruit Doug to carry it out. Claire fires Homeland Security Secretary Nora Cafferty for withholding intelligence.

house-of-cards:S06E08.title: Chapter 73
house-of-cards:S06E08.summary: Claire announces that the Justice Department is investigating Francis for manipulating the 2016 election, while Janine publishes Doug's claim that Francis left him everything. Nathan Green resigns, Annette makes a show of reconciliation with Claire, and the Shepherds finalise a plan with an insider in the White House. Claire turns an ICO nuclear threat into a public standoff with Petrov, threatens a first strike, empties the White House and identifies her military aide as a traitor. Doug arrives with the names of the people who want her dead, confesses that he killed Francis, and demands that she admit she is glad. Claire kills him with the letter opener Francis gave him.

peaky-blinders:S01E01.title: Episode 1
peaky-blinders:S01E01.summary: Birmingham, 1919. Tommy Shelby, back from France with gallantry medals, runs the Peaky Blinders' illegal betting business in Small Heath with his brothers Arthur and John and his Aunt Polly. His men have stolen the wrong crate from the BSA factory: 25 Lewis machine guns, rifles, pistols and ammunition bound for Libya. Winston Churchill sends Chief Inspector Campbell from Belfast to recover them; Campbell arrives with Protestant recruits, beats Arthur as an 'introduction' before offering him a deal, and plants an undercover operative, Grace, as a barmaid in the Garrison pub. Tommy promises Polly he will dump the guns, then moves them to a secret lock-up because the size of the manhunt tells him they are worth a price. He also starts a three-stage race fix around a 'magic' horse, and stages the execution of shell-shocked Danny Whizz-Bang to satisfy the Italians while secretly sending Danny to London.

peaky-blinders:S01E02.title: Episode 2
peaky-blinders:S01E02.summary: While the Shelbys are at the horse fair, Campbell raids the Communists and smashes up every pub that pays the Peaky Blinders for protection, sparing only the Garrison and letting it be known that Arthur agreed to it. Tommy refuses to parley from the back foot: he stages a burning of the King's portraits in front of a newspaper reporter, which brings a midnight rebuke from Churchill down on Campbell. Only then does he meet Campbell at the Lickey Tea Rooms, where he reveals he holds the guns and trades their eventual return for police protection and a clear run at the racetracks. Ada is pregnant by the Communist Freddie Thorne; Tommy promises Campbell that Freddie will leave the city while privately warning Freddie to take Ada and go. Tommy provokes a feud with the Lee family, cashes in the final stage of the Monaghan Boy fix, and when Billy Kimber arrives to punish him, turns the confrontation into talk of an alliance against the Lees.

peaky-blinders:S01E03.title: Episode 3
peaky-blinders:S01E03.summary: Two IRA sympathisers offer Tommy money for the guns; Grace follows one of them and shoots him, going well beyond Campbell's orders. Ada marries Freddie, Polly fails to buy them out of the city, and Campbell's men tell Tommy to hand over Freddie or see Ada charged with sedition. Tommy wins Arthur back, after keeping the guns from him, by buying him a pub that will also launder the family's money. At Cheltenham the Peaky Blinders chase the Lees off Kimber's bookies, hand every recovered penny back to Kimber, and pitch themselves as his racetrack security in return for a cut and legal pitches. Kimber adds Grace as a condition of the deal; Tommy sends her to Kimber's house, then pulls her out by telling Kimber she has syphilis. Danny warns from London that the IRA believe the Peaky Blinders killed their man, and Tommy asks for a parley.

peaky-blinders:S01E04.title: Episode 4
peaky-blinders:S01E04.summary: The Lees rob the Shelby betting shop and leave a grenade trap meant for Tommy, who then quietly opens peace talks with the Lee family. To keep Freddie and Ada safe, Tommy trades Campbell a bigger target, the Communist Stanly Chapman and £200 of Russian money; Campbell gives his word, breaks it the moment Chapman is in custody, and warns Tommy of the savagery he will unleash on the family if Churchill sacks him before the guns are returned. Grace, now promoted to book-keeper, gets Arthur to explain where contraband is stored, and Tommy catches her in another lie but hires her anyway. Tommy tests John's fiancée Lizzie Stark and hands John the result, then marries John to Esme Lee to end the war with the Lees. Kimber grants the Shelbys their first legal pitch. At Ada's labour Tommy declares a truce, and police arrest Freddie as his son is born; the family blames Tommy.

peaky-blinders:S01E05.title: Episode 5
peaky-blinders:S01E05.summary: Tommy marks a 'black star day' in his diary, the secret date he will take out Kimber, and tells no one except Grace. His estranged father returns and cons Arthur out of £500 with a dream of an American casino. IRA commander Malachi Byrne arrives demanding the guns; Tommy pretends to agree a sale, then brings the deal to Campbell as a trap, and at midnight in the Garrison Grace shoots the IRA men. Grace works out from Arthur's slips that the guns are buried in Danny Whizz-Bang's lead-lined grave and trades the location for Campbell's word that Tommy will not be harmed; Campbell recovers the guns, proposes to Grace, is refused, and sends his men after Tommy anyway. With his leverage gone, Tommy hides at Grace's lodgings, while Arthur, abandoned by his father, attempts suicide and is brought back by Tommy with a third share in Shelby Brothers Limited.

peaky-blinders:S01E06.title: Episode 6
peaky-blinders:S01E06.summary: On black star day Tommy tells the family the plan: the Lees, now kin through John's marriage, will join the Shelbys in turning on Kimber's men at the Worcester races. Polly reconciles Ada with Tommy, whose men spring Freddie from a prison van. Campbell taunts Tommy that his heart will be broken before the day is over; word arrives that Kimber's men are driving on Small Heath, tipped off through the police by Grace's leak, and Campbell stands down every officer so the gangs can destroy each other. Tommy turns the Garrison into a fort, Freddie arrives with the one Lewis gun the police never recovered, Ada walks into no-man's land to stop a massacre, and Tommy shoots Kimber. With Kimber's men busy in Birmingham, the Lees take the Worcester pitches unopposed, and Shelby Brothers Limited becomes the third largest legal racetrack operation in the country, while Campbell tells Churchill he has plans for the Peaky Blinders.

peaky-blinders:S02E01.title: Episode 1
peaky-blinders:S02E01.summary: Two years on, the Shelbys are rich and Tommy announces an expansion into London, which Polly, Esme and Ada all resist. The Garrison pub is blown up by Irish republicans who then recruit Tommy for 'a vacancy', and he answers by showing he has researched their leader's family. Tommy quietly kills a man named Duggan (a test set by Major Campbell, who is now head of an Irish Desk in London and is watching him), then takes Arthur and John to London on Newmarket day to wreck Sabini's club and signal to Alfie Solomons' Jewish gang that he wants an alliance. Campbell tells his superior that Tommy is being prepared for a bigger task and will be disposed of afterwards. Sabini retaliates: his men try to abduct Ada and they beat Tommy nearly to death.

peaky-blinders:S02E02.title: Episode 2
peaky-blinders:S02E02.summary: Campbell reveals he saved Tommy's life and now owns him through evidence of the Duggan murder. Tommy discharges himself from hospital, travels to London by canal boat and pitches Alfie Solomons on an alliance against Sabini. He then goes over Campbell's head with a letter to Winston Churchill, who grants him an Empire export licence and a temporary royal appointment in return for an assassination. Tommy buys Polly a house, finds her lost children in the parish records (her daughter Anna is dead, her son Michael alive) and quietly plants his address on the boy while refusing to give it to Polly. Arthur kills a young boxer in the ring, Campbell turns the corrupt Inspector Moss into his informant, and Sabini's police allies are ordered to finish Tommy.

peaky-blinders:S02E03.title: Episode 3
peaky-blinders:S02E03.summary: Michael arrives at Polly's house and the family absorbs him while Tommy tries to send him home. Tommy builds his London machine: men 'stood up' for arrest to help police hit their quotas, Billy Kitchen hired to bring the Black Country gangs onside, and a hundred Birmingham men enrolled as 'bakers' in Alfie's Camden bakery. Sabini hits back by having a stood-up Shelby bookie killed in Winson Green prison, and Tommy needles Campbell by revealing his lodgings are run by a semi-retired brothel keeper. Tommy spends 2,000 guineas on a filly at Doncaster to get the family into the owners' enclosure at Epsom, meets the trainer May Carleton, and survives an ambush on the drive home.

peaky-blinders:S02E04.title: Episode 4
peaky-blinders:S02E04.summary: Campbell and the pro-treaty Irish reveal they are working together and order Tommy to kill a man; Tommy refuses, then exposes a spy in their ranks and demands proof of his death before he will deal. The Peakys take the Eden Club in London, Tommy starts smuggling Scotch to prohibition Canada inside car-part crates covered by his export licence, and he manipulates Polly into letting Michael take a job in the company. Tommy starts an affair with May Carleton, puts his affairs in order through a trust fund, and warns Campbell that his death has been arranged to trigger Campbell's. Meanwhile Sabini apologises to Alfie, concedes Epsom and signs a written peace between the Jews and Italians against the Gypsies.

peaky-blinders:S02E05.title: Episode 5
peaky-blinders:S02E05.summary: Alfie invites Arthur and Billy Kitchen to a Passover seder that is a trap: Billy is killed, Arthur is framed for his murder and police raid every Shelby operation, while Michael is arrested for helping Arthur burn down a pub. Campbell explains he now holds the lives of Arthur, Michael and Ada because Tommy's own life was not enough leverage, and he extracts sex from Polly as the price of Michael's release. Tommy recruits the Lee family through Esme, reunites with Grace (now married in New York) and uses her to taunt Campbell. He then firebombs Field Marshal Russell's house, which wrecks Campbell's assassination plan, and dictates a new venue: Epsom on Derby Day.

peaky-blinders:S02E06.title: Episode 6
peaky-blinders:S02E06.summary: Tommy writes an insurance letter naming Campbell, gets Arthur freed when every witness withdraws, and bluffs Alfie with a hidden grenade into a new deal. On Derby Day Russell is killed, an IRA alarm pulls every policeman to the King, and the Peakys, the Lees and Billy's men burn Sabini's bookmaking licences at gunpoint while Tommy sits Sabini down in the owners' enclosure. Grace tells Tommy she is carrying his child, and May promises to use her racing-board influence to hand Sabini's pitches to Tommy. Campbell's Ulster gunmen take Tommy to be executed but Churchill's people call it off because Churchill has a job for him, and Polly shoots Campbell dead. Michael chooses to stay and join the business, and Tommy says he plans to marry.

peaky-blinders:S03E01.title: Episode 1
peaky-blinders:S03E01.summary: Tommy marries Grace at his country house while her cavalry-officer relatives look down on the Shelbys, and he orders his men into strict good behaviour for her sake. The same night the White Russians make contact through Churchill's channel: a man calling himself Kaledin sits at the wedding, but the Grand Duchess Tatiana arrives with 10,000 dollars and the pre-agreed code name exposes him as a Soviet infiltrator, whom Arthur takes out and kills. John runs a doped-horse race for 'charity' to make noise while the deal is done, Grace tricks Polly into confirming that the business has started, and Polly meets the portrait painter Ruben Oliver. Tommy tells Arthur the job is a factory robbery of armoured vehicles for the Whites, which they cannot refuse, and which will pay for a wharf in Boston.

peaky-blinders:S03E02.title: Episode 2
peaky-blinders:S03E02.summary: Tommy frightens the Lanchester factory foreman into handing over the keys to the bay where armoured cars are stored, and meets Father John Hughes, the go-between for a shadowy establishment group (the Economic League, Section D, the Odd Fellows) that starts dictating terms and inserting itself into the Shelby Foundation. Before meeting Duke Mikhail Romanov at the Ritz, Tommy learns from the maitre d' that the Duke is deep in debt, and uses it to extract sapphires as payment. At home, Polly and Arthur try to defuse the Changretta family's anger over Angel and Lizzie with a face-saving apology, but John cuts Angel and Tommy backs escalation, ordering two Changretta pubs seized. Section D has Tommy arrested by Scotland Yard's Flying Squad to show their reach and threaten Ada and his son; at the Foundation dinner the logistics of the robbery are set, Tatiana unsettles Grace, and an Italian gunman shouting 'For Angel!' shoots Grace.

peaky-blinders:S03E03.title: Episode 3
peaky-blinders:S03E03.summary: Grace is dead and Tommy runs the family by lists and separate meetings, putting legitimate business first and angering Arthur and John, who feel like hired muscle. He orders Vicente Changretta taken at Liverpool and his wife killed; Arthur and John spare the wife and Tommy kills Vicente himself. The factory foreman is ordered to sack communist workers to provoke a general strike, and is tested with a list that deliberately omits one name. Tommy asks Ada to use her communist contacts to find the leak, frightens the Lloyd's underwriter James Monkland into revealing the chain, and at the Romanovs' dinner lays out the full robbery plan before naming Father Hughes as the traitor through Tatiana. Arthur learns Linda is pregnant.

peaky-blinders:S03E04.title: Episode 4
peaky-blinders:S03E04.summary: News arrives that the Shelbys' father has been killed in Boston. Tommy reveals the second robbery to his inner circle: since the Russians cannot be trusted to pay, they will rob the Romanov treasury on the night of the factory job. Polly confesses in church that a holy man is to be killed, the women of the company join Jessie Eden's Good Friday strike, and Linda uses the leaked plan to negotiate Arthur's share from 25,000 up to 41,000. Tatiana spends a destabilising night at Tommy's house and lets slip clues to where the treasury is, and Tommy plants a Russian-speaking burglar in the Romanov household. Section D, tipped off through Polly's confession, beats Tommy, threatens to take his son and forces him to recite a public act of contrition to Hughes; that night Tommy goes through Ada to the Soviet embassy and reveals that the robbery is bait, then collapses with a head injury.

peaky-blinders:S03E05.title: Episode 5
peaky-blinders:S03E05.summary: The Soviets accept Tommy's alternative: remove the firing pins from the guns rather than blow up the train. Tommy buys land by Hampton Court, camps the Lee families on it as cover, and brings in his old wartime tunnellers to dig under the river to the Romanov strong room. He hires Alfie Solomons as his jeweller for the payment selection inside the treasury, where Alfie spots paste and forces the Russians to add a Faberge egg. The Russians strip-check the brothers for tattoos, the inside man reports that the Russians plan to kill the three brothers at the coal yard, and Ada joins the company as Head of Property and Acquisitions. Michael tells Tommy that Hughes abused him as a child and asks to kill him; Tommy agrees, and Polly threatens to bring the organisation down if her son pulls the trigger.

peaky-blinders:S03E06.title: Episode 6
peaky-blinders:S03E06.summary: At the opening of the Grace Shelby Institute, Hughes claims an office and Charles is kidnapped. Hughes tells Tommy that Section D always wanted an explosion: Tommy must blow up the train himself with six men aboard, scatter forged evidence against Soviet officials, and hand over all the stolen jewels and a Faberge egg by 5am. Tommy accuses his own family of leaking, then uses Alfie's withheld name to prove Alfie sold him out and to identify the Odd Fellow holding his son; Charles is rescued, Michael kills Hughes, the tunnel reaches the strong room and Tatiana signs a legal bill of sale for the jewels. Tommy pays everyone, apologises, and then tells them the police are coming: he has made a deal with people more powerful than their enemies, and the family is arrested.

peaky-blinders:S04E01.title: The Noose
peaky-blinders:S04E01.summary: Arthur, John, Michael and Polly are marched to the gallows and saved at the last second when the King's office intervenes: Tommy has traded a stolen royal letter for their lives and, cheekily, an OBE. A year later the family has scattered, Polly is ruined by prison tablets and seances, and Tommy lives alone at his country house running a web of factories held through shell companies. Union convenor Jessie Eden confronts him over unequal pay for women and he answers with a divisive counter-offer. On Christmas Eve every Shelby receives a black hand from Luca Changretta, son of the mafia boss Tommy and Arthur killed. Tommy spots an assassin planted in his kitchen, kills him, sends the chef back to Darby Sabini as a messenger and orders the family home to Small Heath; John refuses and is gunned down on his doorstep with Michael on Christmas morning.

peaky-blinders:S04E02.title: Heathens
peaky-blinders:S04E02.summary: John is dead, Esme leaves with the children, and Michael survives four bullets. Tommy gathers the family, forces a vote to set aside their feud for the duration of the vendetta, and hires Aberama Gold, a feared Gypsy fighter, as a paid killer. He uses John's funeral pyre as bait, leaking its time and place to local Italians hoping to make names for themselves, whom Gold's men shoot. Tommy faces down Gold's attempt to grab Charlie Strong's yard, learns that what Gold really wants is a career for his boxer son Bonnie, and takes the boy on. He provokes Jessie Eden into calling a strike, and Luca Changretta walks into his office disguised as a French trade delegate to announce the terms of the vendetta in person.

peaky-blinders:S04E03.title: Blackbird
peaky-blinders:S04E03.summary: Tommy breaks the strike with blackleg labour protected by Peaky Blinders wearing special constable badges. Polly returns as company treasurer on better terms, and while Linda keeps Arthur away, the board votes to give Luca's photograph to Aberama Gold, taking the killing out of Arthur's hands. Arthur, humiliated, kills two Italian hitmen himself when they are let into the factory. Tommy traces the leak through his manager Devlin, visits Jessie Eden posing as a special constable and each uses personal research on the other. The episode closes with Polly meeting Luca Changretta and offering him Tommy in exchange for sparing the rest of the family.

peaky-blinders:S04E04.title: Dangerous
peaky-blinders:S04E04.summary: The mother of a boxer Arthur killed invites him to a memorial, and Tommy turns the obvious trap into a counter-ambush, only to find it is a decoy: Luca's real target is Michael in hospital, whom Luca spares with a message that Polly's deal stands. Aberama Gold blocks the Italians' escape road and wounds a policeman on purpose to force them underground. May Carleton visits and Tommy keeps her in town with an invented strike; he shows her his gin distillery for the American Prohibition market. Ada makes Jessie Eden a settlement offer from Tommy, full pay parity in exchange for a private dinner, and Alfie Solomons arrives with a giant fighter for Bonnie while warning that the Mafia is here to stay.

peaky-blinders:S04E05.title: The Duel
peaky-blinders:S04E05.summary: Luca's men come for Tommy at the time and place Polly gave them, and Tommy, waiting for them, kills three before Inspector Moss stops the fight; the betrayal was a plan agreed between Tommy and Polly. Lizzie tells Tommy she is pregnant. Polly hides Michael with travelling Gypsies, Luca buys Alfie Solomons' help to put his men inside the fight as Alfie's seconds, and Colonel Ben Younger has Ada arrested so the neighbourhood will see it. Tommy explains that Younger has recruited him to infiltrate Jessie Eden's circle and find the armed revolutionaries, in exchange for military vehicle contracts worth two million pounds, and he wins Jessie's confidence over dinner. The episode ends at the fight, with Luca's men in the ring corner.

peaky-blinders:S04E06.title: The Company
peaky-blinders:S04E06.summary: During the fight, Luca's men attack Arthur and Tommy publicly announces that his brother is dead, while in secret Arthur is only wounded. Tommy sends Michael to New York after learning he knew about Polly's deal and did not warn him. Luca demands the whole Shelby empire as the price of peace, takes over Solomons, Sabini and the Titanics, and comes to Birmingham to collect, where Tommy reveals that Luca's own hired men now work for Al Capone and rival New York families, and Arthur kills Luca. Tommy shoots a dying Alfie in Margate, hands Colonel Younger the name of a Soviet agent in the Birmingham Communist Party and asks for more, and is elected Labour Member of Parliament for Birmingham South.

peaky-blinders:S05E01.title: Black Tuesday
