In the Mediterranean, Sindric persuades Bjorn to send most of his fleet home and appear as traders.

vikings:S05E04.title: The Plan
vikings:S05E04.summary: Heahmund persuades Aethelwulf to blockade York and starve the Northmen out, and reinforcements arrive under Judith's cousin Mannel. Inside the starving town, Ivar has his men pretend to burn their dead and hints to Hvitserk at a plan based on what the Romans built. Ubbe returns to Kattegat and makes a pact with Lagertha against their separate enemies, while Margrethe presses Ubbe to see himself as the rightful ruler. In Sicily, Bjorn signs on as bodyguard to Commander Euphemius until Sindric discovers that Euphemius is a client of the Emir Ziyadat Allah, and Bjorn resolves to meet the real power. Astrid agrees to marry Harald, and at the end the Saxons find the Northmen and their ships apparently gone from York.

vikings:S05E05.title: The Prisoner
vikings:S05E05.summary: The Saxons march into York to celebrate Mass and are ambushed by Northmen who emerge from hiding; Mannel dies covering the royal family's escape and Heahmund is captured. Bjorn and Halfdan meet Ziyadat Allah, who trades with everyone and makes no needless enemies, then serves them a feast that turns out to be Euphemius, punished for double crossing him. Floki returns to Kattegat claiming to have found a land of the gods and, against Lagertha's explicit order, secretly recruits families to leave with him. Ivar and Hvitserk decide to leave York garrisoned and ally with Harald to take Kattegat, taking Heahmund along as a prize.

vikings:S05E06.title: The Message
vikings:S05E06.summary: Ivar and Hvitserk arrive at Harald's town and agree an alliance: Ivar will be King of Kattegat, with Harald promised the throne afterwards, an arrangement Ivar privately calls just words. Guthrum betrays Floki's secret exodus to Lagertha, but she lets all the would be emigrants go. Floki leads his followers to a barren land they must walk into. Astrid bribes a whaler, Hakon, to carry word of the coming attack to Lagertha, and he extorts her with the threat of exposing her. Ivar gives Heahmund a choice between fighting for him or dying, and tests him in front of a hostile crowd. Lagertha threatens Margrethe for undermining her, and Alfred leaves for Lindisfarne to learn about his real father.

vikings:S05E07.title: Full Moon
vikings:S05E07.summary: Bjorn returns to Kattegat with Halfdan just as Lagertha learns of the planned attack, and Lagertha has already called in the Sami as allies; Bjorn marries Snaefrid, daughter of the Sami king. Bjorn, Ubbe and Lagertha plan to intercept Ivar on ground that suits them rather than wait in the town. Floki reaches the valley he calls the land of the gods and preaches an equal community without kings, but Eyvind accuses him of wanting to rule. Ivar draws Heahmund into his strategic thinking, and Astrid tells Harald she is pregnant. Margrethe urges Ubbe to let Ivar overthrow Lagertha so that Ubbe will become king. Alfred visits Lindisfarne and tells the abbot to preach in English.

vikings:S05E08.title: The Joke
vikings:S05E08.summary: The two armies meet, and the leaders parley after exchanging brothers as hostages: Hvitserk goes to Bjorn's camp and Halfdan to Harald's, and each side uses the visit to try to turn the hostage. Bjorn argues that Ivar loses whether he wins or not, and Ivar seems to agree to peace before revealing it was a joke and demanding Kattegat's surrender. In the battle, Ivar suspects a flanking move against his ships and holds back a third of his army, then waits too long to commit it; his side is routed and Heahmund is left for dead and taken by Lagertha. In Iceland, Kjetill Flatnose pushes a taxed temple to Thor and Eyvind's family refuses to pay. Alfred proposes building a navy to stop the raids before they land.

vikings:S05E09.title: A Simple Story
vikings:S05E09.summary: Harald blames Ivar's cleverness for the defeat, and Hvitserk uses a promise Rollo once made him to bring a large Frankish force to Ivar's side. Bjorn goes to parley, and Ivar reads the appeal as a sign that Bjorn expects to lose. Heahmund, saved by Lagertha, becomes her lover and pledges to fight for her. In Wessex, Aethelwulf dies suddenly, and Judith has Aethelred refuse the crown and buys Lord Cuthred's support with the bishopric of Sherborne so that the witan chooses Alfred. In Iceland, Kjetill warns Floki that Eyvind wants to be king, a feud over the temple tax turns violent, and the temple burns.

vikings:S05E10.title: Moments of Vision
vikings:S05E10.summary: The battle for Kattegat is fought and Lagertha's side is overwhelmed. Harald kills his brother Halfdan, and Astrid, carrying Harald's child, forces Lagertha to kill her. Hvitserk admits he may regret leaving Ubbe, while Ivar mocks him. In Iceland the feud leaves sons dead on both sides; Floki offers Eyvind the post of law giver on condition that the revenge ends, and then offers himself as a sacrifice. In Kattegat Margrethe, hoping to make Ubbe king, has turned against Bjorn's children, and Ubbe and Torvi prepare to flee before Ivar arrives.

vikings:S05E11.title: The Revelation
vikings:S05E11.summary: Ivar and King Harald celebrate taking Kattegat, but Ivar says he feels hollow while Lagertha lives, and scouts hunt for her, Bjorn and Ubbe. Rollo arrives from Frankia, sets the terms of a trade and defence pact, finds the fugitives in their old hiding place and offers Bjorn safe passage because he believes Bjorn is his son; Bjorn refuses and nearly kills him. The fugitives decide to go to England under Bishop Heahmund's protection and leave the mad Margrethe behind, and Rollo only reveals where they were after Ivar and Harald agree to a huge tribute, by which time the camp is empty. In Iceland Floki offers himself as a sacrifice to end the blood feud, and the vote narrowly refuses it. In Wessex, King Alfred's first Witan clashes with the Church, Judith tells him to secure his throne with heirs, and Ivar meets Freydis, a freed slave who tells him the gods have marked him out.

vikings:S05E12.title: Murder Most Foul
vikings:S05E12.summary: Lagertha's party reaches the royal villa fearing Heahmund has sold them out, but Alfred, on Heahmund's advice, offers shelter in return for fighting other Vikings and holds back the promised East Anglia grant until they prove themselves. Heahmund finds his bishopric given to Lord Cuthred, who is plotting against Alfred; Cuthred collects proof of Heahmund's affair with Lagertha and writes to warn him off, and Heahmund kills him in the cathedral. Alfred privately asks Ubbe to be baptised so that he is no longer seen to harbour pagans. In Kattegat Ivar names Freydis his queen and she announces she is carrying his child; Margrethe begs Hvitserk to kill Ivar and is then murdered. In Iceland the crops fail and the feud between Eyvind's and Kjetill's families deepens.

vikings:S05E13.title: A New God
vikings:S05E13.summary: Harald sails for England and at York persuades Ivar's regent, Jarl Olavsonn, to raid Wessex with him and then help overthrow Ivar. Hvitserk accuses Ivar of ordering Margrethe's death, and Ivar, coached by Freydis, announces that he is a god and prepares a great public sacrifice. Heahmund tells Alfred he killed Cuthred to break a conspiracy, and Alfred uses a single Witan to restore Heahmund, announce his marriage to Elsewith and present Ubbe and Torvi's baptism. Aethelred chooses Cuthred's daughter as his bride. Magnus, who says he is Ragnar's son by Queen Kwenthrith, introduces himself to Bjorn, and in Iceland Floki brokers a truce just before the pregnant Thorunn disappears.

vikings:S05E14.title: The Lost Moment
vikings:S05E14.summary: Ivar sacrifices a woman he presents as Lagertha, but the crowd sees she is not and chants for Lagertha and Ragnar. He hangs townspeople accused of rebellion and kills the Seer after an unflattering prophecy. Alfred tells the Vikings they must fight Harald or lose their refuge and land, Magnus urges Bjorn to join Harald and destroy Wessex, and the family splits over whether he can be believed. Lord Cyneheard recruits Aethelred for a coup at the war council, but when the moment comes Aethelred cannot give the signal. In Iceland Thorunn's body is found, murdered by Helgi's brother Asbjorn, and Floki expels Eyvind's family into the winter.

vikings:S05E15.title: Hell
vikings:S05E15.summary: Alfred swears to grant East Anglia if the Vikings help him win, then has Lord Cyneheard arrested for treason as the army marches out, and Judith has him tortured for names. Ubbe goes to Harald's camp to negotiate a payment while Bjorn's plan moves the Wessex army round Harald's flank to a battleground they have prepared with burnt ground and catapults; Harald realises too late that the talks were a cover. Wessex wins, Heahmund is killed and Lagertha vanishes. Magnus deserts to Harald. Ivar publicly vows to find whoever killed the Seer, and Cyneheard finally names Aethelred as the conspiracy's leader.

vikings:S05E16.title: The Buddha
vikings:S05E16.summary: Alfred seals the grant of East Anglia to the Vikings and, at the same ceremony, has the conspirators arrested. The defeated Harald faces angry jarls at York and presents Magnus as a son of Ragnar to restore confidence. Bjorn frees the captured shield maiden Gunnhild, then decides to retake Kattegat and goes to Harald, armed with Gunnhild's knowledge that Harald already planned to overthrow Ivar. Judith extracts Aethelred's confession; when Alfred collapses with illness and Aethelred starts courting the nobles, she poisons him. In Iceland Kjetill persuades Floki to rescue Eyvind's starving family, and in Kattegat Ivar recruits King Olaf the Stout for a spring attack on York.

vikings:S05E17.title: The Most Terrible Thing
vikings:S05E17.summary: Alfred recovers to find Aethelred dead, and Judith confesses she poisoned him and tells Alfred that a king must be ready to do terrible things. Ivar tells Kattegat that it will no longer vote on everything and rallies the crowd against hidden enemies, then forces Hvitserk to go to Olaf by threatening to burn his lover Thora. In Iceland Kjetill's family kills Eyvind's family, revealing that the rescue was a revenge plan. Bjorn and Harald agree terms for a winter attack on Kattegat, with Harald named Bjorn's successor, while Gunnhild keeps Harald's hopes alive. A Danish army lands in the west and Ubbe asks Alfred to give him command.

vikings:S05E18.title: Baldur
vikings:S05E18.summary: Hvitserk reaches King Olaf, is stripped and tested, and asks Olaf to attack Ivar rather than join him; in Kattegat Ivar burns Thora. Bjorn marries Gunnhild, and Harald hides his resentment behind a toast. Floki refuses to take revenge on Kjetill and leaves the settlement. Lagertha is found alive and returned to Wessex, where Judith reveals she is dying. Ubbe meets three Danish kings and offers them land in East Anglia instead of war; two accept, King Frodo refuses and Ubbe challenges him to single combat. Freydis gives birth to a deformed son, Baldur, whom Ivar abandons, and Olaf agrees to join Hvitserk against Ivar.

vikings:S05E19.title: What Happens in the Cave
vikings:S05E19.summary: Ubbe kills Frodo in single combat and three thousand Danes join the East Anglia settlement, which Alfred blesses; Ubbe then renounces the cross and returns to the old gods, and Lagertha leaves with him. A winter storm scatters Bjorn and Harald's fleet, Harald threatens to make a deal with Ivar instead, and Gunnhild talks them out of fighting each other. Ivar accuses Freydis of lying about Baldur's paternity while she tells the people the gods took the child. With York lost and Olaf not arriving, Ivar cancels his campaign and presents it as strengthening Kattegat's defences. Hvitserk meets Bjorn on the march and declares that his fate is to kill Ivar.

vikings:S05E20.title: Ragnarok
vikings:S05E20.summary: Ivar prepares Kattegat for a siege, with earls in every district raising soldiers, while Bjorn, Harald, Hvitserk, Olaf and Lagertha close in. A simultaneous assault on two gates fails with heavy losses, and Bjorn appeals to the townspeople over Ivar's head while Ivar tells them Bjorn's plans do not include them. Freydis, whose child Ivar killed, slips out through Ivar's secret escape passage and offers to open it for the attackers. The attackers enter, Ivar confronts and kills Freydis, and Bjorn is hailed King of Kattegat. The episode ends with warnings that power corrupts and that the war is not over.

vikings:S06E01.title: New Beginnings
vikings:S06E01.summary: Six months after the fall of Ivar, Bjorn is King of Kattegat and announces he will make it an open trading town instead of a walled fortress. He wants Lagertha at his side, but she refuses: she is done with war and rule, and retires to rebuild her old farm alone. In the east, the fleeing Ivar and his bodyguard Vigrid are captured by the Kievan Rus. Prince Oleg, called the Prophet, tortures and kills Vigrid, learns Ivar's story, and tests his claim to divinity with a balloon flight. The two men bond over their ruthlessness (Oleg describes killing his unfaithful wife), and Oleg reveals he means to reclaim the Rus ancestral lands in Scandinavia, with Ivar's help.

vikings:S06E02.title: The Prophet
vikings:S06E02.summary: Messengers tell Bjorn that King Olaf has seized King Harald's kingdom and holds him prisoner; Harald, who has saved Bjorn's life twice, asks for help, and Bjorn decides to go against Lagertha's advice. Kjetill Flatnose sails into Kattegat alone and gives a thin account of the Iceland settlement and of Floki's disappearance. In Rus, Oleg's brother Dir arrives to arrest him, but Oleg produces Dir's secret wife Anna and recounts the details of the secret wedding, and Dir backs down. Oleg explains the legend behind his name (a dream that his wine was poisoned at Constantinople), and once back in Kiev with Ivar and the young heir Igor, he has Dir attacked and imprisoned. Lagertha settles into farm life, but raiders are nearby.

vikings:S06E03.title: Ghosts, Gods and Running Dogs
vikings:S06E03.summary: Widows from nearby villages visit Lagertha, then return with news that they have been attacked, raped and robbed by bandits, and Lagertha takes up her sword again and tells them the truth about their situation. Bjorn leaves Ubbe as steward of Kattegat, where he rules capably, and sails to rescue Harald. In his cell, Harald promises his jailer Canute a kingdom. Bjorn's men swim ashore at night toward Olaf's stronghold, but Olaf has spread oil on the water and sets it alight, then traps the survivors between walls of fire and archers. In Kiev, Ivar sees that Oleg is a threat to the boy Igor and to himself, and starts to befriend Igor.

vikings:S06E04.title: All the Prisoners
vikings:S06E04.summary: Olaf summons his prisoners Bjorn and Harald and makes a surprising offer: the kings and jarls of Norway should elect one king of all Norway, and Olaf wants it to be Bjorn. Harald agrees while privately resenting the idea, since uniting Norway has always been his own ambition. Lagertha organises her village, posting boys and girls as scouts, and when White Hair's bandits attack the villagers drive them off, but many die, including the young Hali. In Kattegat, Ubbe is wary of giving the drunken Hvitserk a role in a trade mission. In Kiev, Ivar finds the imprisoned Dir, who offers anything for his freedom, and Ivar tells him that he wants to overthrow Oleg.

vikings:S06E05.title: The Key
vikings:S06E05.summary: The kings and jarls of Norway gather at Harald's capital of Tamdrup for the election, with Olaf confident that Bjorn will win. Harald quietly works on the other voters, while Bjorn makes the case for fighting others rather than each other. Lagertha's village waits for the next attack, and Gunnhild arrives with reinforcements. In Kiev, Ivar and Igor free Dir from his cage, using a naked woman to distract the guards, and Oleg responds by killing the guards. Oleg announces he will marry Princess Katia, who looks exactly like Ivar's dead wife Freydis, and Ivar is shaken.

vikings:S06E06.title: Death and the Serpent
vikings:S06E06.summary: The election goes against Bjorn: Harald wins the votes of Thorkell, Hrolf and Hakon through private promises while publicly voting for Bjorn himself, and Olaf crowns Harald the first King of all Norway. Harald's men then try to kill Bjorn, who is saved by an outlaw named Erik and escapes. Lagertha's villagers trap the returning bandits in a fenced maze and stab them through the slats, and Lagertha kills White Hair in single combat but is badly wounded. On her way to Kattegat she meets Hvitserk, deranged by drink and visions, who kills her believing she is a serpent sent by Ivar. In Kiev, Oleg marries Katia and makes Ivar watch them consummate the marriage.

vikings:S06E07.title: The Ice Maiden
vikings:S06E07.summary: Kattegat gives Lagertha a great funeral. Gunnhild asks for a shieldmaiden to volunteer to accompany Lagertha to Valhalla; she turns down the pregnant Torvi, and another shieldmaiden is chosen. Hvitserk is found in the forest and brought back but says nothing about Lagertha. Harald imprisons Olaf, who refuses to renounce his lands and insists Bjorn should have been king. In Kiev, Katia demands a hot spring in the frozen winter and Oleg grants it, and a messenger tells Ivar that Dir is in hiding and will help him overthrow Oleg.

vikings:S06E08.title: Valhalla Can Wait
vikings:S06E08.summary: Bjorn learns that Hvitserk killed Lagertha, puts him on trial and sentences him to burn, but Ubbe throws his axe to cut the ropes, and Bjorn banishes Hvitserk instead, telling him that a forgotten life is a worse punishment than death. Gunnhild loses her baby, and when she finds Bjorn with Ingrid she offers Ingrid her freedom and proposes that Bjorn take two wives. Ubbe and Torvi leave Kattegat for Iceland. Oleg sends Rus raiders into Norway: one plants a flag at Istrehagan near Vestfold before horsemen slaughter the village, and the new King Harald turns to his prisoner Olaf for advice. In Kiev, Oleg refuses to let Ivar lead a raid or take Igor, and slaps Igor into submission in front of Ivar.

vikings:S06E09.title: Resurrection
vikings:S06E09.summary: Bjorn marries Ingrid, which upsets Gunnhild. Worried about the Rus, Bjorn sends Erik to patrol the borders; Erik's band runs into a Rus scouting party that seems to be waiting for them, with hidden archers and men ready to encircle, and both sides pull back. Ivar, who led the scouting party, finds the lost Hvitserk and brings him to Kiev, where a messenger from Dir tells Ivar the plan against Oleg is moving. Hvitserk sees no likeness between Katia and Freydis. Olaf persuades Harald to join forces with Bjorn, and Ivar watches, stunned, as Oleg's enormous army marches out of Kiev. Ubbe and Torvi reach Iceland and meet a wanderer named Othere who speaks of lands further west.

vikings:S06E10.title: The Best Laid Plans
vikings:S06E10.summary: Bjorn and Harald prepare to meet the Rus invasion near Vestfold, but most of the other kings and jarls refuse to answer their call. Bjorn plans for every approach he can think of and fortifies the beach he expects the Rus to land on. Ivar, who knows the ground, designs the Rus attack: shallow barges for a mass landing, and a force that goes up the supposedly safe river mouth and climbs the cliffs to hit the defenders from inland. The Norwegians are overwhelmed, Harald falls, and Ivar and Bjorn meet on the beach, where Ivar stabs Bjorn. Katia tells Ivar she is working with Dir, and in Iceland Othere reveals that Kjetill and his son Frodi murdered Eyvind's family, leaving Ubbe with a decision.

vikings:S06E11.title: King of Kings
vikings:S06E11.summary: After the battle on the beach, Oleg celebrates with Ivar, but Ivar cannot be sure he killed Bjorn. Harald and King Olaf are dragged before Oleg in chains: Oleg spares Harald, meaning to use him, and makes young Prince Igor set Olaf alight. Harald escapes, refusing to be anyone's puppet. The mortally wounded Bjorn, whom the Rus believe dead, rides out alone in front of his army, takes several arrows and still raises his sword; the Rus see a man who cannot be killed, and with Norwegian reinforcements under King Hakon and Jarl Hrolf arriving, Oleg orders a retreat. Bjorn dies and is buried in a mound as Gunnhild speaks of his legacy.

vikings:S06E12.title: All Change
vikings:S06E12.summary: Kattegat mourns Bjorn and the throne is empty. Gunnhild, his first wife and a warrior, is the natural successor, but Ingrid announces she is carrying Bjorn's child, and Gunnhild questions whether it is Harald's. Erik, a former outlaw with his own ambitions, starts playing the two widows against each other. In Kiev, Oleg tells Katia he was beaten by a dead man; he separates Igor from Ivar while Ivar and Igor plot with Oleg's exiled brother Dir to overthrow him, and Katia coaxes the plan out of Ivar in bed. In Iceland, Kjetill tells his wife he regrets murdering Eyvind's family and joins Ubbe's voyage west hoping for redemption.

vikings:S06E13.title: The Signal
vikings:S06E13.summary: Kattegat holds an election for its ruler. Ingrid presses her claim through Bjorn's unborn child, Erik refuses to say whom he backs, and then Harald sails into the harbour with his men, declares that he is still King of all Norway, and with Erik's support is made king; he announces he will take Bjorn's widows as his own. In Kiev, Ivar receives the signal from Dir that his forces are ready; after a brutal fight between the brothers, Hvitserk suggests using the Easter rites as cover, and Ivar, Hvitserk, Katia and Igor smuggle themselves past the gates in a cart while Oleg watches the Good Friday procession. At sea near Iceland a storm scatters Ubbe's fleet and Torvi's daughter is lost.

vikings:S06E14.title: Lost Souls
vikings:S06E14.summary: Oleg senses something is wrong when Igor misses the Good Friday ceremony, and discovers that his wife and heir have gone. Igor is greeted as a hero in Novgorod, where Dir and Ivar plan their attack on Kiev. Oleg tells his council that Ivar has joined Dir and that victory is certain, but flashbacks and his behaviour show a man coming apart. Ubbe and Torvi grieve their lost child. In Kattegat, Harald declares he wants to marry both Gunnhild and Ingrid.

vikings:S06E15.title: All at Sea
vikings:S06E15.summary: Oleg, undone by Katia's betrayal, is brought down and Igor, following Ivar's lead, kills him with an arrow; Igor takes Kiev. Katia tells Ivar she carries his child but will not marry him, and Ivar and Hvitserk leave Kiev. In Kattegat, Harald marries Ingrid, while Gunnhild, refusing to become his wife, walks into the sea to drown and join Bjorn. In Greenland, the self-proclaimed king Kjetill fences off a beached whale from the starving settlers; the revolt that follows leaves many dead, and Ubbe, Torvi and Othere escape in a leaking boat with no supplies or sunstone.

vikings:S06E16.title: The Final Straw
vikings:S06E16.summary: Adrift at sea, Ubbe's group is dying of thirst; a man who drinks seawater dies, tension grows between Ubbe and Othere, and when baby Ragnar weakens Ubbe nearly kills Othere. Ivar and Hvitserk return to Kattegat, where crowds heckle them and Ivar wonders if coming back was a mistake. Harald instead welcomes them to a feast, seeing an opportunity. Ivar proposes taking the fight back to Wessex and King Alfred, speaking of faded heroes and the chance to be Vikings again, and Harald agrees. Erik sees Ivar as an obstacle.

vikings:S06E17.title: The Raft of Medusa
vikings:S06E17.summary: Harald leaves Erik to rule Kattegat with Ingrid beside him and sails for England with Ivar, Hvitserk and the fleet. Hearing that the sons of Ragnar have landed, Alfred abandons his royal villa, telling Queen Elsewith it is only property and that staying alive matters more, and marches to meet them while the Viking army camps and waits. In Kattegat, Erik begins losing his sight; Ingrid is using witchcraft on him, and by the end he is fully blind. Ubbe's starving boat reaches a strange new land, suggesting Othere's promised land is real.

vikings:S06E18.title: It's Only Magic
vikings:S06E18.summary: Alfred has mustered a large army; he suffers a seizure, recovers, cuts off his hair and gives his troops a rousing speech. Ivar tells Harald and Hvitserk that he knows how to win: he will cripple the Saxons rather than kill them. Ivar is shaken to learn he is fated to die, and Hvitserk tells him his eyes have turned blue, a sign his bones are about to fail. The blinded Erik realises Ingrid has used magic on him and offers one of his slaves freedom in return for killing her. In the new land, Ubbe and Othere follow carvings to a settlement and are surrounded by a native tribe with drawn bows.

vikings:S06E19.title: The Lord Giveth...
vikings:S06E19.summary: Ivar's battle plan unfolds in the woods: bear traps, spikes and hidden pits cripple the Saxons, warriors burst out of camouflaged holes in the ground, and archers in the trees pour down arrows and burning oil. Alfred insists the Lord is with them and refuses to retreat, but the Vikings win the day. Harald is run through by a Saxon who tells him he will die alone and be forgotten; he kills the man and dies. In Kattegat, Ingrid confronts the slave Erik sent to kill her and has him hanged in public, while a female slave kills Erik. In the new land, the natives lead Ubbe to their Norse teacher, who turns out to be Floki.

vikings:S06E20.title: The Last Act
vikings:S06E20.summary: Ivar asks Alfred for a parley and offers hostages and promises, but Alfred reads him as a man who does not want peace and gives him a choice: leave England for good or die. In the final battle Ivar, his body failing, tells Hvitserk to go, and is killed; Hvitserk returns to kneel beside him and Alfred calls off the fighting. Hvitserk renounces the old gods, is baptised and is renamed Athelstan. Kattegat learns that Harald and Ivar are dead and hails Ingrid as queen. In the new land Floki tells Ubbe to let the past go; when a settler kills a native child over gold, Ubbe executes the killer, and the tribe lets the settlers stay while making clear they do not own the land.
